description:
Differential testing of `pkix-chain::verify_*` against pyca/cryptography for the canonical purposes.

pyca has `x509.verification.PolicyBuilder` (RFC 6125-binding TLS verifier) and is the second oracle per AGENTS.md test discipline. `pkix-difftest` already has a pyca oracle for path validation.

Per purpose:
- **TLS server** — `PolicyBuilder().store(...).time(...).build_server_verifier(DNSName(...))` vs `pkix_chain::verify_tls_server`.
- **TLS client** — `build_client_verifier(...)`.
- **S/MIME** — pyca's S/MIME path may not exist; fall back to OpenSSL only.
- **Code signing** — pyca doesn't ship a code-signing verifier; OpenSSL only.

Acceptance: per-purpose pass-rate documented in `pkix-difftest/baseline-verify-pyca.md`. Coverage gaps (where pyca doesn't support a use case) documented.

**Blocks on:** .15.
title: Differential testing against pyca/cryptography for canonical purposes
